Marissa / Sanjay —

Attaching a packet with tracing hook snippets and a short recommended alert routing mapping. Highlights below:

Tracing hooks (examples included in tracing-hook-snippets.txt):
- Agent side: add middleware that emits span.name = "redwood.request" with attrs: model.name, seq.length, client.id
- Server side: capture kv-cache hits as span.event = "kv_cache_hit" (bool) and token.count as metric
- Env vars we recommend: REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT, REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE (0.05 for staging), REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE_SIZE

Dashboard recommendations (seed panels):
- Tokens/sec (global) and per-model throughput
- Latency p50/p95/p99 by model and seq length bucket
- KV cache hit rate and cache evictions

Alert routing mapping (example):
- Severity: P0 (customer-impacting latency) -> paging to oncall + severity Slack channel + SMS
- P1 (degraded throughput) -> ops email + CS triage channel
- P2 (warnings) -> aggregated daily digest to product ops

Attached: tracing-hook-snippets.txt (plain text), short JSON mapping file (referenced in the drive link). If you want, we can open a small PR to your repo with an instrumentation middleware sample before kickoff.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
